_annotation: Raw JSON-RPC exchange against the ticket-history MCP server, with field annotations.
_model_call_location: The model call happens BETWEEN tools/list and tools/call. The host sends discovered tool schemas to the LLM (Groq API), the LLM decides which tool to call, and THEN the host sends tools/call to the MCP server. No model call happens during initialize or tools/list -- those are pure protocol negotiation and discovery.

exchanges._step: 1. initialize -- client and server introduce themselves and agree on protocol version

_request_annotations.id: Correlation id -- the response must carry the same id so client can match reply to request
_request_annotations.method: 'initialize' -- the RPC method: start the handshake
_request_annotations.params.protocolVersion: Which MCP protocol version the client speaks
_request_annotations.params.capabilities: What the client can handle (empty = basic tool calling only)
_request_annotations.params.clientInfo: Self-identification: name and version of the calling agent

_response_annotations.id: Same id as the request -- proves this response belongs to that request
_response_annotations.result.protocolVersion: The protocol version the server agreed to use
_response_annotations.result.serverInfo.name: The server's self-identified name

exchanges._model_call_here: NO -- this is pure protocol negotiation, no AI involved

exchanges._step: 2. tools/list -- client asks the server what tools it offers (like requesting a menu)

_request_annotations.method: 'tools/list' -- asks the server to enumerate all available tools

tools.name: lookup_ticket_history
tools.description: Look up the full lifecycle history of a support ticket by ticket_id (format: Tnnn, e.g. T002, T008). Returns the creation timestamp, status change timeline, and list of assigned agents.

tools.name: get_escalation_history
tools.description: Get the escalation chain for a support ticket by ticket_id (format: Tnnn, e.g. T003, T008). Returns escalation events with timestamps, agents, reasons, and level.

_response_annotations.result.tools: Array of tool definitions the server exposes
_response_annotations.tools[].name: The tool name the model will reference in tool_use blocks
_response_annotations.tools[].description: The docstring the model reads to decide when to call this tool -- acts as a prompt
_response_annotations.tools[].inputSchema: JSON Schema describing the arguments the tool accepts

exchanges._model_call_here: NO -- this is discovery. The host collects the tool list and will pass it to the LLM next.

exchanges._explanation: The host takes the discovered tool schemas from tools/list, converts them to OpenAI format, and sends them to the LLM (Groq API) along with the user's message. The LLM decides which tool to call and outputs a tool_use block with the tool name and arguments. The host then sends that as a tools/call request to the MCP server.

exchanges._step: 3. tools/call -- host sends the tool call the LLM chose to the server for execution

_request_annotations.method: 'tools/call' -- execute a specific tool on the server
_request_annotations.params.name: Which tool to invoke (chosen by the LLM, not hard-coded)
_request_annotations.params.arguments: The arguments the LLM provided for this tool call

content.text: {"ticket_id": "T008", "escalations": [{"ticket_id": "T008", "escalated_at": "2025-06-13T12:00:00Z", "from_agent": "agent-D", "to_agent": "agent-E", "reason": "Order O208 not found in system -- possible data integrity issue", "level": 2}]}

_response_annotations.result.content: Array of content blocks returned by the tool (text, images, etc.)
_response_annotations.result.content[].type: 'text' -- this block contains plain text (the tool result as JSON)
_response_annotations.result.content[].text: The actual tool output -- fed back to the LLM for the next turn
_response_annotations.result.isError: false = the result is valid and the model can use it; true = hard failure

exchanges._model_call_here: NO at this step -- but the host sends this result BACK to the LLM for another model call to produce the final answer.
